title: Beginner Launchpad Level 2
description: A real second beginner stage built from coherent novice course topics. Each lesson is a functional mission, not a repeat of Level 1.

lessons.title: Greeting and Names
lessons.canDo: I can introduce myself and ask one follow-up question.
lessons.patternPinyin: Nǐ hǎo, hěn gāoxìng rènshì nǐ.

story.zh: 我第一天上中文課，有點緊張。
story.pinyin: wǒ dì yī tiān shàng zhōng wén kè, yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng.
story.english: It is my first day in Chinese class, and I am a little nervous.

story.zh: 老師走進教室，對大家說：「你們好。」
story.pinyin: lǎo shī zǒu jìn jiào shì, duì dà jiā shuō: nǐ men hǎo.
story.english: The teacher walks into the classroom and says, “Hello everyone.”

story.zh: 我跟旁邊的學生打招呼。
story.pinyin: wǒ gēn páng biān de xué sheng dǎ zhāo hu.
story.english: I greet the student next to me.

story.zh: 她告訴我她的名字，也問我的名字。
story.pinyin: tā gào sù wǒ tā de míng zi, yě wèn wǒ de míng zi.
story.english: She tells me her name and also asks mine.

story.zh: 下課後，我們變成朋友。
story.pinyin: xià kè hòu, wǒ men biàn chéng péng you.
story.english: After class, we become friends.

story.zh: 我很高興認識她。
story.pinyin: wǒ hěn gāo xìng rèn shi tā.
story.english: I am very glad to meet her.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì xīn xué sheng.
dialogue.english: Hello, I am a new student.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ hǎo, wǒ yě shì xué sheng.
dialogue.english: Hello, I am also a student.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: qǐng wèn, nǐ jiào shén me míng zi?
dialogue.english: May I ask, what is your name?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ jiào ān ān, nǐ ne?
dialogue.english: My name is An-an. And you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我叫小明，很高興認識你。
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ jiào xiǎo míng, hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ.
dialogue.english: My name is Xiaoming. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ yě hěn gāo xìng rèn shi nǐ.
dialogue.english: I am glad to meet you too.

lessons.title: People in Class
lessons.canDo: I can talk about teachers, students, and classmates.

story.zh: 今天班上有一位新同學。
story.pinyin: jīn tiān bān shàng yǒu yí wèi xīn tóng xué.
story.english: Today there is a new classmate in class.

story.zh: 老師請大家簡單介紹自己。
story.pinyin: lǎo shī qǐng dà jiā jiǎn dān jiè shào zì jǐ.
story.english: The teacher asks everyone to briefly introduce themselves.

story.zh: 我說我是學生，旁邊的人是我的朋友。
story.pinyin: wǒ shuō wǒ shì xué sheng, páng biān de rén shì wǒ de péng you.
story.english: I say I am a student, and the person next to me is my friend.

story.zh: 老師問我們今天誰沒來。
story.pinyin: lǎo shī wèn wǒ men jīn tiān shéi méi lái.
story.english: The teacher asks who is absent today.

story.zh: 我們一起看座位，回答老師的問題。
story.pinyin: wǒ men yì qǐ kàn zuò wèi, huí dá lǎo shī de wèn tí.
story.english: We look at the seats together and answer the teacher’s question.

story.zh: 這堂課讓我認識更多人。
story.pinyin: zhè táng kè ràng wǒ rèn shi gèng duō rén.
story.english: This class lets me get to know more people.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: nà ge rén shì shéi?
dialogue.english: Who is that person?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: tā shì xīn tóng xué.
dialogue.english: She is a new classmate.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: tā yě shì xué sheng ma?
dialogue.english: Is she also a student?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: shì, tā jīn tiān dì yī cì lái.
dialogue.english: Yes, she came for the first time today.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 我們下課後跟她打招呼吧。
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ men xià kè hòu gēn tā dǎ zhāo hu ba.
dialogue.english: Let’s greet her after class.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: hǎo, wǒ yě xiǎng rèn shi tā.
dialogue.english: Okay, I also want to meet her.

lessons.title: Numbers for Daily Use
lessons.canDo: I can count people, objects, and prices.

story.zh: 我和朋友去買飲料。
story.pinyin: wǒ hé péng you qù mǎi yǐn liào.
story.english: My friend and I go buy drinks.

story.zh: 店員問我們要幾杯。
story.pinyin: diàn yuán wèn wǒ men yào jǐ bēi.
story.english: The clerk asks how many cups we want.

story.zh: 我說我要一杯茶，朋友要兩杯果汁。
story.pinyin: wǒ shuō wǒ yào yì bēi chá, péng you yào liǎng bēi guǒ zhī.
story.english: I say I want one tea, and my friend wants two juices.

story.zh: 我們一起數錢，看看夠不夠。
story.pinyin: wǒ men yì qǐ shǔ qián, kàn kan gòu bù gòu.
story.english: We count the money together to see if it is enough.

story.zh: 店員給我們三杯飲料。
story.pinyin: diàn yuán gěi wǒ men sān bēi yǐn liào.
story.english: The clerk gives us three drinks.

story.zh: 我把兩杯拿給朋友。
story.pinyin: wǒ bǎ liǎng bēi ná gěi péng you.
story.english: I give two cups to my friend.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: qǐng wèn, nǐ yào jǐ bēi?
dialogue.english: May I ask, how many cups do you want?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ yào yì bēi chá.
dialogue.english: I want one cup of tea.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ péng you ne?
dialogue.english: What about your friend?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: tā yào liǎng bēi guǒ zhī.
dialogue.english: He wants two cups of juice.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: suǒ yǐ yí gòng sān bēi, duì ma?
dialogue.english: So three cups in total, right?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: duì, xiè xie.
dialogue.english: Yes, thank you.

lessons.title: Dates and Amounts
lessons.canDo: I can understand larger numbers, dates, and quantities.

story.zh: 今天是星期五，我想買午餐。
story.pinyin: jīn tiān shì xīng qí wǔ, wǒ xiǎng mǎi wǔ cān.
story.english: Today is Friday, and I want to buy lunch.

story.zh: 便當店的飯很多，也不太貴。
story.pinyin: biàn dāng diàn de fàn hěn duō, yě bú tài guì.
story.english: The lunchbox shop has a lot of rice and is not too expensive.

story.zh: 我問老闆一個便當多少錢。
story.pinyin: wǒ wèn lǎo bǎn yí ge biàn dāng duō shǎo qián.
story.english: I ask the owner how much one lunchbox is.

story.zh: 老闆說一個八十元。
story.pinyin: lǎo bǎn shuō yí ge bā shí yuán.
story.english: The owner says one is eighty dollars.

story.zh: 我買兩個，一個給自己，一個給朋友。
story.pinyin: wǒ mǎi liǎng ge, yí ge gěi zì jǐ, yí ge gěi péng you.
story.english: I buy two, one for myself and one for my friend.

story.zh: 我們下午還要一起上課。
story.pinyin: wǒ men xià wǔ hái yào yì qǐ shàng kè.
story.english: We still have class together in the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: jīn tiān jǐ hào?
dialogue.english: What is today’s date?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: jīn tiān wǔ hào, yě shì xīng qí wǔ.
dialogue.english: Today is the fifth, and it is Friday.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.english: How much is one lunchbox?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: yí ge bā shí yuán.
dialogue.english: One is eighty dollars.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ yào mǎi liǎng ge.
dialogue.english: I want to buy two.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: hǎo, yí gòng yì bǎi liù shí yuán.
dialogue.english: Okay, one hundred sixty dollars total.

lessons.title: My Family
lessons.canDo: I can introduce close family members.

story.zh: 晚上我跟家人一起吃飯。
story.pinyin: wǎn shàng wǒ gēn jiā rén yì qǐ chī fàn.
story.english: In the evening, I eat with my family.

story.zh: 爸爸做湯，媽媽準備青菜。
story.pinyin: bà ba zuò tāng, mā ma zhǔn bèi qīng cài.
story.english: Dad makes soup, and Mom prepares vegetables.

story.zh: 哥哥今天回家比較晚。
story.pinyin: gē ge jīn tiān huí jiā bǐ jiào wǎn.
story.english: My older brother comes home a little late today.

story.zh: 妹妹先幫大家拿碗。
story.pinyin: mèi mei xiān bāng dà jiā ná wǎn.
story.english: My younger sister first helps everyone get bowls.

story.zh: 我們坐在一起聊天。
story.pinyin: wǒ men zuò zài yì qǐ liáo tiān.
story.english: We sit together and chat.

story.zh: 我喜歡這樣的家庭時間。
story.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān zhè yàng de jiā tíng shí jiān.
story.english: I like this kind of family time.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ ge rén?
dialogue.english: How many people are in your family?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ ge rén.
dialogue.english: There are five people in my family.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ yǒu gē ge ma?
dialogue.english: Do you have an older brother?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: yǒu, wǒ yě yǒu yí ge mèi mei.
dialogue.english: Yes, I also have a younger sister.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ men cháng yì qǐ chī fàn ma?
dialogue.english: Do you often eat together?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 常常，晚上我們都在家吃。
dialogue.pinyin: cháng cháng, wǎn shàng wǒ men dōu zài jiā chī.
dialogue.english: Often. In the evening we all eat at home.

story.zh: 週末朋友問我家人的工作。
story.pinyin: zhōu mò péng you wèn wǒ jiā rén de gōng zuò.
story.english: On the weekend, my friend asks about my family’s jobs.

story.zh: 我說爸爸是商人，媽媽是醫生。
story.pinyin: wǒ shuō bà ba shì shāng rén, mā ma shì yī shēng.
story.english: I say my dad is a businessperson and my mom is a doctor.

story.zh: 哥哥在公司上班。
story.pinyin: gē ge zài gōng sī shàng bān.
story.english: My older brother works at a company.

story.zh: 妹妹還在學校念書。
story.pinyin: mèi mei hái zài xué xiào niàn shū.
story.english: My younger sister is still studying at school.

story.zh: 朋友覺得我的家人很忙。
story.pinyin: péng you jué de wǒ de jiā rén hěn máng.
story.english: My friend thinks my family is very busy.

story.zh: 我說雖然忙，可是大家都很照顧我。
story.pinyin: wǒ shuō suī rán máng, kě shì dà jiā dōu hěn zhào gù wǒ.
story.english: I say although they are busy, everyone takes good care of me.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: méi yǒu, tā hái shì xué sheng.
dialogue.english: No, she is still a student.

lessons.title: Food Choices
lessons.canDo: I can choose rice, noodles, meat, and vegetables.

story.zh: 中午我和同學去小吃店。
story.pinyin: zhōng wǔ wǒ hé tóng xué qù xiǎo chī diàn.
story.english: At noon, my classmate and I go to a small food shop.

story.zh: 我想吃飯，也想喝湯。
story.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng chī fàn, yě xiǎng hē tāng.
story.english: I want to eat rice and also drink soup.

story.zh: 同學今天不太餓，只點一碗麵。
story.pinyin: tóng xué jīn tiān bú tài è, zhǐ diǎn yì wǎn miàn.
story.english: My classmate is not very hungry today and only orders a bowl of noodles.

story.zh: 店裡的水可以自己拿。
story.pinyin: diàn lǐ de shuǐ kě yǐ zì jǐ ná.
story.english: In the shop, you can get water yourself.

story.zh: 我們一邊吃飯，一邊聊天。
story.pinyin: wǒ men yì biān chī fàn, yì biān liáo tiān.
story.english: We eat and chat at the same time.

story.zh: 這頓午餐簡單，可是很好吃。
story.pinyin: zhè dùn wǔ cān jiǎn dān, kě shì hěn hǎo chī.
story.english: This lunch is simple, but delicious.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān xiǎng chī shén me?
dialogue.english: What do you want to eat today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng chī fàn, yě xiǎng hē tāng.
dialogue.english: I want rice and soup.

dialogue.english: It is over there. You can get it yourself.

lessons.title: Simple Restaurant Order
lessons.canDo: I can order food and say what tastes good.
lessons.patternPinyin: Zhè wèi fúwùyuán tàidù hěn hǎo.

story.zh: 晚上我第一次自己去餐廳點餐。
story.pinyin: wǎn shàng wǒ dì yī cì zì jǐ qù cān tīng diǎn cān.
story.english: In the evening, I order food by myself at a restaurant for the first time.

story.zh: 服務員問我要不要看菜單。
story.pinyin: fú wù yuán wèn wǒ yào bú yào kàn cài dān.

dialogue.english: It is nice in the morning, but it may rain in the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.english: Then should I bring an umbrella?

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.english: Is it cold today?

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.english: Not cold, just a little windy.

lessons.title: Weather and Plans
lessons.canDo: I can say how seasons/weather affect plans.

story.zh: 我們想週末去公園。
story.pinyin: wǒ men xiǎng zhōu mò qù gōng yuán.
story.english: We want to go to the park on the weekend.

story.zh: 如果天氣好，我們可以騎腳踏車。
story.pinyin: rú guǒ tiān qì hǎo, wǒ men kě yǐ qí jiǎo tà chē.
story.english: If the weather is good, we can ride bikes.

story.zh: 如果下雨，就去看電影。
story.pinyin: rú guǒ xià yǔ, jiù qù kàn diàn yǐng.
story.english: If it rains, we will go watch a movie.

story.zh: 朋友先查天氣預報。
story.pinyin: péng you xiān chá tiān qì yù bào.
story.english: My friend checks the weather forecast first.

story.zh: 星期六有太陽，星期日可能下雨。
story.pinyin: xīng qí liù yǒu tài yáng, xīng qí rì kě néng xià yǔ.
story.english: Saturday will be sunny, and Sunday may rain.

story.zh: 所以我們決定星期六出門。
story.pinyin: suǒ yǐ wǒ men jué dìng xīng qí liù chū mén.
story.english: So we decide to go out on Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: zhōu mò nǐ xiǎng qù nǎ lǐ?
dialogue.english: Where do you want to go on the weekend?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 如果天氣好，我想去公園。
dialogue.pinyin: rú guǒ tiān qì hǎo, wǒ xiǎng qù gōng yuán.
dialogue.english: If the weather is good, I want to go to the park.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: rú guǒ xià yǔ ne?
dialogue.english: What if it rains?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: nà wǒ men qù kàn diàn yǐng.
dialogue.english: Then we will go watch a movie.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 星期六看起來天氣比較好。
dialogue.pinyin: xīng qí liù kàn qǐ lái tiān qì bǐ jiào hǎo.
dialogue.english: Saturday looks like the weather is better.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: hǎo, nà jiù xīng qí liù chū mén.
dialogue.english: Okay, then let’s go out Saturday.

story.zh: 下課後我和朋友聊天。
story.pinyin: xià kè hòu wǒ hé péng you liáo tiān.
story.english: After class, I chat with my friend.

story.zh: 她問我平常喜歡做什麼。
story.pinyin: tā wèn wǒ píng cháng xǐ huān zuò shén me.
story.english: She asks what I usually like to do.

story.zh: 我說我喜歡聽音樂，也喜歡看電影。
story.pinyin: wǒ shuō wǒ xǐ huān tīng yīn yuè, yě xǐ huān kàn diàn yǐng.
story.english: I say I like listening to music and watching movies.

story.zh: 她喜歡運動，常常去跑步。
story.pinyin: tā xǐ huān yùn dòng, cháng cháng qù pǎo bù.
story.english: She likes exercise and often goes running.

story.zh: 我們發現都喜歡喝咖啡。
story.pinyin: wǒ men fā xiàn dōu xǐ huān hē kā fēi.
story.english: We discover that we both like drinking coffee.

story.zh: 所以我們約下次一起去咖啡廳。
story.pinyin: suǒ yǐ wǒ men yuē xià cì yì qǐ qù kā fēi tīng.
story.english: So we plan to go to a cafe together next time.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: xià cì wǒ men kě yǐ yì qǐ qù.
dialogue.english: Next time we can go together.

story.zh: 這個週末我想安排一個小活動。
story.pinyin: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng ān pái yí ge xiǎo huó dòng.
story.english: This weekend I want to arrange a small activity.

story.zh: 星期六早上我先去買菜。
story.pinyin: xīng qí liù zǎo shàng wǒ xiān qù mǎi cài.
story.english: On Saturday morning I first go grocery shopping.

story.zh: 下午朋友來我家，我們一起做飯。
story.pinyin: xià wǔ péng you lái wǒ jiā, wǒ men yì qǐ zuò fàn.
story.english: In the afternoon my friend comes to my home, and we cook together.

story.zh: 晚上我們看一部中文電影。
story.pinyin: wǎn shàng wǒ men kàn yí bù zhōng wén diàn yǐng.
story.english: In the evening, we watch a Chinese movie.

story.zh: 星期日我想休息，也想複習功課。
story.pinyin: xīng qí rì wǒ xiǎng xiū xí, yě xiǎng fù xí gōng kè.
story.english: On Sunday I want to rest and also review homework.

story.zh: 這樣的週末不太忙，也不無聊。
story.pinyin: zhè yàng de zhōu mò bú tài máng, yě bù wú liáo.
story.english: This kind of weekend is not too busy and not boring.

dialogue.english: We will cook and watch a movie in the evening.

lessons.canDo: I can name body parts and simple symptoms.

story.zh: 昨天晚上我睡得不太好。
story.pinyin: zuó tiān wǎn shàng wǒ shuì de bú tài hǎo.
story.english: Last night I did not sleep very well.

story.zh: 早上起床時，我覺得頭有點痛。
story.pinyin: zǎo shàng qǐ chuáng shí, wǒ jué de tóu yǒu diǎn tòng.
story.english: When I got up in the morning, I felt my head hurt a little.

story.zh: 我喝了水，也吃了早餐。
story.pinyin: wǒ hē le shuǐ, yě chī le zǎo cān.
story.english: I drank water and ate breakfast.

story.zh: 可是上課的時候還是很累。
story.pinyin: kě shì shàng kè de shí hòu hái shì hěn lèi.
story.english: But during class I was still very tired.

story.zh: 老師叫我下課後休息一下。
story.pinyin: lǎo shī jiào wǒ xià kè hòu xiū xí yí xià.
story.english: The teacher told me to rest after class.

story.zh: 我決定今天早一點睡覺。
story.pinyin: wǒ jué dìng jīn tiān zǎo yì diǎn shuì jiào.
story.english: I decide to sleep earlier today.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ jīn tiān kàn qǐ lái hěn lèi.
dialogue.english: You look very tired today.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ zuó tiān shuì de bú tài hǎo.
dialogue.english: I did not sleep very well yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: nǎ lǐ bù shū fú?
dialogue.english: Where do you feel uncomfortable?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ tóu yǒu diǎn tòng.
dialogue.english: My head hurts a little.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: xià kè hòu xiū xí yí xià ba.
dialogue.english: Rest a bit after class.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: hǎo, wǒ jīn tiān zǎo yì diǎn shuì.
dialogue.english: Okay, I will sleep earlier today.

story.zh: 今天下午我覺得喉嚨痛。
story.pinyin: jīn tiān xià wǔ wǒ jué de hóu lóng tòng.
story.english: This afternoon my throat hurts.

story.zh: 朋友問我要不要去看醫生。
story.pinyin: péng you wèn wǒ yào bú yào qù kàn yī shēng.
story.english: My friend asks whether I want to see a doctor.

story.zh: 我說先喝溫水，看看會不會好一點。
story.pinyin: wǒ shuō xiān hē wēn shuǐ, kàn kan huì bú huì hǎo yì diǎn.
story.english: I say I will drink warm water first and see if it gets better.

story.zh: 晚上我還是咳嗽。
story.pinyin: wǎn shàng wǒ hái shì ké sou.
story.english: In the evening, I am still coughing.

story.zh: 所以我決定明天早上去診所。
story.pinyin: suǒ yǐ wǒ jué dìng míng tiān zǎo shàng qù zhěn suǒ.
story.english: So I decide to go to the clinic tomorrow morning.

story.zh: 朋友提醒我要早點休息。
story.pinyin: péng you tí xǐng wǒ yào zǎo diǎn xiū xí.
story.english: My friend reminds me to rest early.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: nǐ yì zhí ké sou, hái hǎo ma?
dialogue.english: You keep coughing. Are you okay?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: wǒ hóu lóng yǒu diǎn tòng.
dialogue.english: My throat hurts a little.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: yào bú yào qù kàn yī shēng?
dialogue.english: Do you want to see a doctor?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 如果明天還不舒服，我就去。
dialogue.pinyin: rú guǒ míng tiān hái bù shū fú, wǒ jiù qù.
dialogue.english: If I still feel unwell tomorrow, I will go.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: xiān hē yì diǎn wēn shuǐ ba.
dialogue.english: Drink some warm water first.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: xiè xie, wǒ yě yào zǎo diǎn xiū xí.
dialogue.english: Thanks. I also need to rest early.
